parameters.content:
Setup notes

1. Replace agentEndpoint in Workflow Config with your OpenAPI agent endpoint.
2. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail credentials using sajvindersingh8@gmail.com.
3. Replace PUT_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE in both Google Sheets nodes.
4. Keep Daily Schedule Trigger disabled until manual tests work.
5. This workflow is draft + approval only. It does not auto-publish YouTube videos.
